title: Tech Note: The GRAPH Command in 4D V6

historical_commentary.text: The GRAPH command changes in v6 reflect a broader pattern of breaking changes during major 4D version transitions. While the GRAPH command itself has been further modified and partially superseded by more modern charting approaches in later 4D versions, the migration concerns described here are of historical interest.
related_updates: The GRAPH command has undergone further changes in subsequent 4D versions
4D Chart (which supplemented GRAPH) has been discontinued
Modern 4D charting typically uses web-based visualization libraries
